meta.name: ai-amazon-product-bundling
meta.description: Amazon 组合销售助手适合运营、产品、销售、software在用户提出“怎么组合更好卖”这类问题，需要快速拆解目标、判断重点并形成可执行结果时使用，帮助基于输入材料生成商品/店铺诊断、卖点与风险提示、运营动作建议。

copy.tagline: 分析商品组合策略，生成诊断与运营建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果负责亚马逊商品运营，需要快速生成组合销售方案
copy.tagline_en: Analyze product bundling strategies and generate actionable insights
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage Amazon product listings and need bundling recommendations

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会分析你提供的商品信息、店铺链接或运营目标，输出商品/店铺诊断、卖点与风险提示、运营动作建议。
howto.when: 当你提出“怎么组合更好卖”这类问题，或需要围绕 Amazon 商品组合生成诊断和建议时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析这两个商品怎么组合更好卖？
根据我的运营目标，给出商品组合的卖点和风险。
say.note: Claude 会结合你提供的目标（如提高点击率）进行分析。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes your product info, store links, or operational goals, and outputs product/store diagnosis, selling points & risk alerts, and operational action suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask "how to bundle products to sell better" or need diagnosis and suggestions around Amazon product bundling.

say_en.text: Help me analyze how to bundle these two products to sell better?
Based on my operational goals, give me selling points and risks for product bundling.
say_en.note: Claude will combine your goals (e.g., improve click-through rate) for analysis.
